messages:
amanda: Thanks everyone — quick open thread for follow-ups from today’s all-hands about Tuesday's reliability incident. Main RCA is here: https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-03-16-retry-throttle-led-to-backpressure :link: Please post clarifying q's and volunteer owners for action items.

jay: Appreciate the RCA. Two quick clarifications: 1) Do we have a short-term mitigation ETA for the routing fallback? 2) Which teams need to review the throttling thresholds? @sree @matt

sree: For (1) we can push a conservative routing fallback patch by EOD Wednesday to avoid the aggressive retry path. I can own the PR and smoke tests. For (2) infra + serving runtime should review thresholds; I’ll loop in eng-platform.

matt: Can you add the canary config to the PR so we can validate on dedicated capacity without affecting hosted? Also want a perf signal in console for new throttle metric before wide rollout.

amanda: Yes — add canary and a per-route toggle. Who can add the console metric? @lia

lia: I can add a dashboard tile and an alert. ETA Friday morning for dashboards, alert runbook by Monday.

kelsey: I’ll take ownership of updating the incident runbook and the postmortem checklist to include retry-loop detection. Will link docs once done.

paul: Prioritization question from product: are any customer-facing SLAs at risk if we delay the fix until Friday? Need to know if we should escalate to a hotfix.

sree: Short answer — not for most customers. Dedicated customers with high QPS might see degraded p50 for short bursts; SLA impact is low probability. If product wants absolute zero risk, we can accelerate to hotfix tomorrow morning.

jay: OK noted. Product informed — will follow up with affected customers if we do hotfix. Also, can someone paste the minimal repro logs for the retry loop here? Helps the support team.

amanda: Repro snippet from the incident logs (sanitized):
```
2026-03-16T14:02:11Z router: upstream 10.5.2.8 closed stream, retry=1
2026-03-16T14:02:11Z client: request queued (prefix_hit=false)
2026-03-16T14:02:12Z worker: kvcache miss, warming
2026-03-16T14:02:12Z router: retry policy triggered, attempt=4
```

kelsey: Adding action owners summary: (A) Routing fallback patch — sree (PR by Wed EOD). (B) Canary + toggle — sree + matt (include perf metric). (C) Dashboard + alert + runbook — lia (Fri AM / Mon runbook). (D) Runbook & postmortem updates — kelsey (links when done). (E) Customer comms if hotfix — jay/product to decide.

matt: Can we add a short automated smoke test for the KV cache warm path? If we have a tiny CI job that simulates prefix misses we’ll catch regressions early.

sree: Agreed. I’ll add a smoke test to the serving-runtime CI matrix. Expect a small PR after the patch.

deploy-bot: deploy 1779123600 to prod started by sree — rolling canaries (10% traffic) :rocket:

lia: Seeing the canary now in dashboards, :eyes: initial metrics look stable. Will keep a 2h watch window.

paul: Thanks all. One ask from security/compliance: please ensure the RCA link has access permissions updated for customers-involved before we share externally.

amanda: Good catch. I’ll coordinate with security to approve the customer-facing summary and mark versioned public doc.

jay: Anything else? If not, I’ll consolidate these action items in the all-hands follow-up doc and ping owners individually.

amanda: That sounds great. Thanks everyone for quick responses. I’ll close this thread once actions are linked in the follow-up doc.
__notes: Single-string thread with messages in chronological order; metadata fields required by agents.md are included.
